observations.behavior: The test implementation was rewritten to remove a multi-request burst and replace it with a single request, then an explicit clock advance, then a second request, and finally a third request. The removed comments described the previous burst-based testing strategy and its assumptions. The added assertions check the status of each request individually rather than checking a vector.,
